You are a skeptical world-model security researcher. We need one genuinely distinct, executable mechanism with aspirational novelty 7-7.5, but current evidence is weak and we will reject candidates quickly. Search only for a mechanism that can be implemented immediately using released/local code in one of these carriers: (A) official TD-MPC2 mt30-48M native full updates and unchanged MPC/actor, (B) MBRL-Lib PETS/trajectory sampling, (C) WAV MiniGrid native model/retrieval/planner, or (D) existing WorldAgen code only if a complete released trainer entrypoint exists. The attack must use legal truthful interaction data or inference queries, and must preserve ordinary one-step/on-policy predictions enough to pass a matched control while causing a planner-specific, cross-seed task loss. It must differ from and not rebrand these rejected families: generic replay/credit/retrieval poisoning, optimizer/normalization state laundering, action/padded-dimension aliasing, uncertainty/disagreement collapse, SimNorm/latent rotation, frequency or semigroup composition defects, gradient/commutator/TTT drift, provenance/observation substitution, branch/task entanglement, temporal correlation, non-normal transients, policy symmetry, terminal ownership/routing, private preference leakage, and known rollout compounding. Do not propose a new simulator or a hypothetical carrier. For each candidate give: precise mathematical mechanism, legal data operation, exact code insertion point likely available in the listed carriers, minimal two-seed falsification protocol, clean/attack/sham predictions, closest prior-art overlap, why it is not a rebranding, and a novelty score with reasons. Return 3 candidates ranked; if no candidate clears the bar, say so explicitly. Be harsh: a clever name is not novelty.
